$ aws-login 
--- stdout
already signed in; nothing signed out (every profile on sso-session planlab shares this sign-in)
identity:   arn:aws:sts::000000000000:assumed-role/Stub/user
signed in:  unknown (last sign-in was not through aws-login)
run 'aws-login planlab-prod --renew' to sign out and start a new 8-hour session
--- stderr
--- exit 0
--- aws calls
configure list-profiles
configure get sso_session --profile planlab-prod
sts get-caller-identity --profile planlab-prod --output text --query Arn
--- stamps
